name: Proper Conditionings of Minimal-Non-Ample Classes Are UOM Fibers
statement: After fixed coordinates are suppressed, every nonempty proper iterated conditioning of a conditioning-minimal non-ample class belongs to UOMFib.
proof: For a parent with at least three concepts, the classification makes it a non-free simple uniform-oriented-matroid tope set, and fixing coordinates selects a topal fiber. A rank-one two-concept parent conditions to singleton cubes. Both outputs are UOMFib members.
